::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/usage_alerts"}
#docs
An alert on usage, spend, credit balance or credit runway, for one `customer` or for every subscription to a `product` (including later ones). Each threshold triggers once per period and resolves when the value moves back or the period ends. A customer alert of the same kind and meter wins over a plan alert. Alerts never block or charge.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | **yes** | The usage alert's kind. One of `usage_quantity`, `spend`, `credit_balance`, `credit_runway`. |
| `customer` | `string` | no | One customer (cus_…). Send this or product. |
| `product` | `string` | no | Every subscription to this product. Send this or customer. |
| `meter` | `string` | no | Meter key. |
| `interval` | `string` | no | day, week (ISO, from Monday) and month are calendar intervals in the business's time zone. period is the term of the subscription that bills the usage. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `period`. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | ISO 4217. |
| `unit` | `string` | no | Credit unit key. |
| `thresholds` | `array of object` | **yes** | The usage alert's thresholds. |
| `thresholds.value` | `number` | **yes** | The threshold. A whole number except for units. |
| `thresholds.unit` | `string` | **yes** | minor (money, spend and balance), units (meter units or credit units), percent (of the spend limit, the meter feature's limit, or the credit granted), days (runway). One of `minor`, `units`, `percent`, `days`. |
| `email` | `boolean` | no | The usage alert's email address. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_alert`. One of `usage_alert`. |
| `id` | `string` | ualt_… |
| `kind` | `string` | The usage alert's kind. One of `usage_quantity`, `spend`, `credit_balance`, `credit_runway`. |
| `scope` | `string` | The usage alert's scope. One of `customer`, `plan`. |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_…, for customer scope. |
| `product` | `string` | The product, for plan scope. |
| `meter` | `string` | Meter key: usage (required) and spend (optional). |
| `interval` | `string` | day, week (ISO, from Monday) and month are calendar intervals in the business's time zone. period is the term of the subscription that bills the usage. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `period`. |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. All kinds but usage. |
| `unit` | `string` | Credit unit key, for balance and runway. Null: money. |
| `thresholds` | `array of object` | The usage alert's thresholds. |
| `email` | `boolean` | Email the customer when a threshold triggers. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True if the usage alert is active. |
| `created_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `states` | `array of object` | Customer alerts only. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | The usage alert. |
| `400` | The body is not correct. |
| `404` | No such customer or product. |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |
| `422` | A rule refused the value. `param` names the field. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/usage_alerts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "kind": "usage_quantity",
    "interval": "day",
    "currency": "USD",
    "thresholds": [
      {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "minor"
      }
    ],
    "email": false
  }'
```
